app.title: Fileditor - Visual File Editor
app.aboutSubtitle: Visual Multi-Format Editor for JSON, XML, Markdown & ToDo
app.feature3: XML & JSON Editor with Multi-Schema Validation (Draft-04..2020-12, JTD, XSD, DTD, RelaxNG, Schematron)
app.feature5: Session File Recovery and Vector PDF Export
app.feature6: Optional support for Docusaurus callouts, custom hotkeys, accent themes, and more.

app.noteDesc: This free open-source hobby project was developed transparently with the assistance of AI.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoCheckUpdatesDesc: Check in the background on startup for new Fileditor releases on GitHub.
settings.dateSupportDesc: Automatically parse and format timestamps inside Markdown previews.
settings.dateSupportTooltip: Formats Discord timestamps <t:timestamp:x> and @date(datetime) tags as interactive badges in the Markdown preview.
settings.markdownWidthDesc: Default width of the Markdown preview when entering fullscreen.
settings.markdownZoomDesc: Default zoom level when entering fullscreen.
settings.fileTypesDesc: Choose which file formats are active in the application.
settings.textNoSpecific: Plain text files have no format-specific settings.
settings.markdownSyncEditorFromPreviewDesc: Jumps to and highlights the corresponding source line when clicking in the live preview.
settings.markdownSyncPreviewFromEditorDesc: Scrolls to and highlights the matching preview block when selecting lines in the editor.
settings.txtDesc: Plain text files without live preview.
settings.xmlDesc: Structured XML editing with visual Column, Tree, and Table views.
settings.jsonDesc: JSON editing with visual Column, Tree, and Table views.
settings.mdDesc: Synchronized live preview, callouts, and vector PDF export.
settings.todoDesc: Multi-list task workspaces, priority indicators, and hashtags.
settings.docusaurusTooltip: Renders Docusaurus admonition blocks (:::tip, :::warning, etc.) and strips YAML frontmatter in the preview.
settings.configTxtDesc: Plain text files have no extra modal options. Use the editor toolbar and status bar for word wrap, line numbers, and encoding.
settings.configXmlSchemasDesc: XML documents can be validated against XSD 1.0/1.1 (.xsd), DTD (.dtd & inline DOCTYPE), RelaxNG XML (.rng), and ISO Schematron (.sch).
settings.configJsonSchemasDesc: JSON documents can be validated against JSON Schema Draft-04, Draft-06, Draft-07, Draft 2019-09, Draft 2020-12, and JSON Type Definition (JTD / RFC 8927).
settings.defaultViewJsonDesc: Default view mode for newly opened JSON files. Each file remembers its own view mode afterwards.
settings.defaultViewXmlDesc: Default view mode for newly opened XML files. Each file remembers its own view mode afterwards.
settings.autoNumDesc: Automatically inserts the next list item ("2. ") when pressing Enter.
settings.preserveNumDesc: Displays the exact written list numbers in the preview without browser renumbering.
settings.autoCompleteChildrenDesc: Checking a parent task also completes its nested subtasks.
settings.autoCollapseParentDesc: Automatically collapses a parent task when marked complete.
settings.shortcutsDesc: Click edit on any action and press your desired key combination.
settings.shortcutHint: Press the desired key combination (e.g. Ctrl + Shift + K). Modifiers are detected automatically.
settings.hotkeysResetSuccess: All keyboard shortcuts reset to defaults.
settings.graphEnabledTooltip: Enables the interactive 2D document and knowledge graph viewer.
settings.graphEnabledDesc: Interactive 2D graph viewer for cross-file links and ToDo lists.
settings.backupRetentionTooltip: Controls how many days closed or discarded drafts remain available under File > Restore.
settings.backupRetentionDesc: Retention period for closed unsaved drafts across instances.
settings.markdownRememberViewState: Remember Fullscreen & Scroll Position per File
settings.markdownRememberViewStateDesc: Saves fullscreen state, width, zoom, and scroll position per Markdown document.
settings.todoHideCompletedDesc: Hides completed tasks in the default view behind a compact counter divider.
settings.todoCascadingIndentDesc: Indenting or outdenting a task moves its nested child tasks along with it.
settings.colorsDesc: Personalize accent colors across the code editor, Markdown preview, and UI.
settings.colorThemeReset: All accent colors reset to defaults.
settings.unsavedDesc: You have unsaved settings changes. Discard them?
